```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  link-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install mdlinkcheck
        run: pip install mdlinkcheck

      - name: Check README links
        run: mdlinkcheck README.md

  memory-mcp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: link-check
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
        with:
          uv-version: '0.4.20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: memory-mcp
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: Lint
        working-directory: memory-mcp
        run: uv run ruff check .

      - name: Test
        working-directory: memory-mcp
        run: uv run pytest -v

  wifi-cam-mcp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: link-check
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
        with:
          uv-version: '0.4.20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: wifi-cam-mcp
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: Lint
        working-directory: wifi-cam-mcp
        run: uv run ruff check .
```
